instruction: A candid full-shot photograph captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls. On the right, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands with his back to the camera, watching his partner. In the center-left, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt (R2) balances on her right leg while kicking her left leg out toward him. Overhead studio lights illuminate the scene, casting soft shadows on the red carpet. The camera is positioned at eye-level, capturing the full interaction.
